name: Haman
summary: Haman the Agagite was raised by King Ahasuerus over all the princes. Furious that Mordecai would not bow to him, he plotted to wipe out all the Jews, but he was hanged on the gallows he had built for Mordecai.

key_moments.title: Furious at Mordecai
key_moments.description: King Ahasuerus set Haman over all his princes, and the king's servants bowed to him. When Mordecai would not bow, Haman was full of anger and planned to wipe out all the Jews in the kingdom.

key_moments.title: Wins a Decree to Destroy the Jews
key_moments.description: Lots were cast before Haman to choose a day, and he persuaded the king to let a people be destroyed. Letters sealed with the royal ring were sent to every province to kill every Jew on one day.

key_moments.title: Has Gallows Built for Mordecai
key_moments.description: Haman went home glad after Esther's banquet, but the sight of Mordecai at the gate spoiled it all. His wife Zeresh and his friends told him to build a tall gallows to hang Mordecai on, and he had it made.

key_moments.title: Leading Mordecai's Horse
key_moments.description: Haman thought the king wanted to honor him and described a royal parade. Then the king told him to do it all for Mordecai, and Haman went home mourning with his head covered.

key_moments.title: Hanged on His Own Gallows
key_moments.description: When Esther named Haman as her enemy, he was afraid and begged her for his life. The king had him hanged on the gallows he had built for Mordecai.
